gloss: front and back, before and after

definitions.gloss: front and back, before and behind
definitions.explanation: The area or direction in front and behind something. Spatial orientation.
The time immediately before and after an event. Also used to indicate approximate time.
The surrounding context or circumstances of a situation.

examples.japanese: {前後|ぜんご}を{確認|かくにん}してから{発車|はっしゃ}してください。
examples.english: Please check front and back before starting the car.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}は{午後|ごご}3{時|じ}{前後|ぜんご}に{起|お}きた。
{文脈|ぶんみゃく}の{前後|ぜんご}から{意味|いみ}を{推測|すいそく}する。
examples.english: I infer the meaning from the surrounding context.

examples.japanese: {前後|ぜんご}{左右|さゆう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check all directions (front, back, left, right).

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{前後|ぜんご}に{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: Be careful of the front and back of the car.

examples.japanese: {列|れつ}の{前後|ぜんご}の{人|ひと}と{話|はな}した。
examples.english: I talked to the people in front and behind me in line.

examples.japanese: {順番|じゅんばん}の{前後|ぜんご}が{入|い}れ{替|か}わった。
{正午|しょうご}{前後|ぜんご}に{届|とど}く{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: It's expected to arrive around noon.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}の{前後|ぜんご}は{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: I'm busy before and after departure.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{前後|ぜんご}に{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: Take medicine before and after meals.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{前後|ぜんご}で{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: I practiced before and after the match.

examples.japanese: {1週間|いっしゅうかん}{前後|ぜんご}かかる。
{話|はなし}の{前後|ぜんご}が{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I don't understand the context of the story.

examples.japanese: {前後|ぜんご}の{事情|じじょう}を{説明|せつめい}してください。
{前後|ぜんご}の{流|なが}れを{見|み}てから{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: I'll judge after seeing the overall flow.

examples.japanese: {発言|はつげん}の{前後|ぜんご}を{確認|かくにん}しないと、{本当|ほんとう}の{意味|いみ}は{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: Unless you check the context around the statement, you can't understand its true meaning.

notes:
USAGE PATTERNS:

1. SPATIAL (front/back):
- {前後|ぜんご}{左右|さゆう} (front, back, left, right - all directions)
- {前後|ぜんご}を{見|み}る (to look front and back)

2. TEMPORAL (around a time):
- {3時|さんじ}{前後|ぜんご} (around 3 o'clock)
- {事件|じけん}の{前後|ぜんご} (around the time of the incident)

3. CONTEXTUAL:
- {前後|ぜんご}の{文脈|ぶんみゃく} (surrounding context)
- {話|はなし}の{前後|ぜんご} (the context of the story)

EXPRESSION: {前後|ぜんご}{不覚|ふかく} = losing consciousness, being in a daze
